record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>, for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>.<Fo><Fo> As the hart<WH0354> panteth<WH06165><WTH8799> after the water<WH04325> brooks<WH0650>, so panteth<WH06165><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315> after thee, O God<WH0430>. <RF>Maschil...: or, A Psalm giving instruction of the sons, etc<Rf> <RF>panteth: Heb. brayeth<Rf>
My soul<WH05315> thirsteth<WH06770><WTH8804> for God<WH0430>, for the living<WH02416> God<WH0410>: when shall I come<WH0935><WTH8799> and appear<WH07200><WTH8735> before<WH06440> God<WH0430>?
My tears<WH01832> have been my meat<WH03899> day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>, while they continually<WH03117> say<WH0559><WTH8800> unto me, Where <FI>is<Fi> thy God<WH0430>?

When I remember<WH02142><WTH8799> these <FI>things<Fi> , I pour out<WH08210><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315> in me: for I had gone<WH05674><WTH8799> with the multitude<WH05519>, I went<WH01718><WTH8691> with them to the house<WH01004> of God<WH0430>, with the voice<WH06963> of joy<WH07440> and praise<WH08426>, with a multitude<WH01995> that kept holyday<WH02287><WTH8802>.

Why art thou cast down<WH07817><WTH8709>, O my soul<WH05315>? and <FI>why<Fi> art thou disquieted<WH01993><WTH8799> in me? hope<WH03176><WTH8685> thou in God<WH0430>: for I shall yet praise<WH03034><WTH8686> him <FI>for<Fi> the help<WH03444> of his countenance<WH06440>. <RF>cast: Heb. bowed<Rf> <RF>praise: or, give thanks<Rf> <RF>for the...: or, his presence is salvation<Rf><CM>

O my God<WH0430>, my soul<WH05315> is cast down<WH07817><WTH8709> within me: therefore will I remember<WH02142><WTH8799> thee from the land<WH0776> of Jordan<WH03383>, and of the Hermonites<WH02769>, from the hill<WH02022> Mizar<WH04706>. <RF>the hill...: or, the little hill<Rf>
Deep<WH08415> calleth<WH07121><WTH8802> unto deep<WH08415> at the noise<WH06963> of thy waterspouts<WH06794>: all thy waves<WH04867> and thy billows<WH01530> are gone<WH05674><WTH8804> over me.

<FI> Yet<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> will command<WH06680><WTH8762> his lovingkindness<WH02617> in the daytime<WH03119>, and in the night<WH03915> his song<WH07892> <FI>shall be<Fi> with me, <FI>and<Fi> my prayer<WH08605> unto the God<WH0410> of my life<WH02416>.

I will say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto God<WH0410> my rock<WH05553>, Why hast thou forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> me? why go<WH03212><WTH8799> I mourning<WH06937><WTH8802> because of the oppression<WH03906> of the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>?

<FI> As<Fi> with a sword<WH07524> in my bones<WH06106>, mine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802> reproach<WH02778><WTH8765> me; while they say<WH0559><WTH8800> daily<WH03117> unto me, Where <FI>is<Fi> thy God<WH0430>? <RF>sword: or, killing<Rf>

Why art thou cast down<WH07817><WTH8709>, O my soul<WH05315>? and why art thou disquieted<WH01993><WTH8799> within me? hope<WH03176><WTH8685> thou in God<WH0430>: for I shall yet praise<WH03034><WTH8686> him, <FI>who is<Fi> the health<WH03444> of my countenance<WH06440>, and my God<WH0430>.<CM>
